title: get_job_results inputSchema
description: Argument shape for reading one caller-readable geoprocessing job's terminal result package. Status polling stays on list_jobs. Advertised name honua_get_job_results. x-honua-extension: this is a documented Honua extension over the bare taxonomy, pending formalization in the geospatial-mcp standard. x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation.

jobId.description: Identifier of a geoprocessing job the caller can read (from a submission result or honua_list_jobs).
